scope: 马耳他消费者法（Consumer Affairs Act, Cap. 378，含 2005/29/EC 不公平商业行为与 First Schedule 黑名单）、价格标示条例（S.L. 378.09）、消费者权利条例（S.L. 378.17，2011/83/EU）、产品安全法（Cap. 427）、低压电气设备条例（S.L. 427.34，2014/35/EU）、无线电设备条例（S.L. 427.41，2014/53/EU）、电气配件条例（S.L. 427.51，BS 1363 插头）、通用产品安全实施条例（S.L. 427.106，GPSR (EU) 2023/988）、GDPR 与电子通信领域数据处理条例（S.L. 586.01）。品类聚焦小家电、家居用品与 3C 数码。支付/物流/退换（Layer 3）、食品/美妆/玩具、能源标签逐品类映射不在本版范围。
quote_verification: 全部 54 条 verbatim_excerpt 均为官方文本子串：马耳他法例取自 legislation.mt 官方 PDF（pdftotext -raw），EU 条例取自 EUR-Lex 渲染文本；去除页眉页脚与边际注记、空白归一化后由 mt/verify_excerpts.py 逐条断言，54/54 通过。两条因 PDF 分页/页眉插入而按不跨页的短句截取（MT-ADV-02、MT-ADV-05）。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示「法条原文 + 页面原文」同时成立时可给规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判「需要证明」；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的 12 条必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论；confidence=medium 的条目须在报告中标注不确定性。

rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Regulations (S.L. 378.17) 消费者权利条例
rules.requirement: 线上下单按钮必须清晰标注付款义务（如「order with obligation to pay」）；未满足时消费者不受合同约束。
rules.evidence_needed: 结算页按钮文案与位置截图、下单流程录屏。
rules.penalty_or_note: Cap. 378 art. 106A：罚款 €470–€47,000；未合规时消费者不受订单约束（reg. 9(2) 但书）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Provided that the trader shall ensure that the consumer, when placing his order, explicitly acknowledges that the order implies an obligation to pay. If placing an order entails activating a button or a similar function, the button or similar function shall be labelled in an easily legible manner only with the words 'order with obligation to pay' or a corresponding unambiguous formulation indicating that placing the order entails an obligation to pay the trader.

rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Regulations (S.L. 378.17) 消费者权利条例
rules.requirement: 交易网站必须在下单流程开始时清楚标明是否存在配送限制以及接受哪些支付方式。
rules.evidence_needed: 下单首屏截图、配送国家/地区限制、支付方式清单。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) Trading websites shall indicate clearly and legibly at the latest at the beginning of the ordering process whether any delivery restrictions apply and which means of payment are accepted.

rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Regulations (S.L. 378.17) 消费者权利条例
rules.requirement: 信息义务的合规举证责任在经营者一方：页面是否在下单前披露了 reg. 5(1) 的各项信息，由卖家证明，而非由消费者证明其缺失。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面版本存档（带时间戳）、A/B 测试记录、下单流程留痕、邮件确认副本。
rules.penalty_or_note: 举证责任倒置（reg. 7）；违反实体信息义务按 Cap. 378 art. 106A 处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: As regards compliance with the information requirements laid down in this Part, the burden of proof shall be on the trader.

rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Regulations (S.L. 378.17) 消费者权利条例
rules.requirement: 必须披露付款与交付安排、交付期限，以及（如适用）投诉处理政策；只写「7–14 个工作日」而不给最迟期限或投诉渠道，存在缺口。
rules.evidence_needed: 配送政策页、承诺时效、投诉入口与处理流程。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (g) the arrangements for payment, delivery, performance, the time by which the trader undertakes to deliver the goods or to perform the services and, where applicable, the complaint handling policy of the trader;

rules.law_name: Low Voltage Electrical Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.34) 低压电气设备条例
rules.requirement: 低压电气设备本体（或包装/随附文件）必须带型号、批次或序列号等可识别标识；商品页只写营销名而无型号，属可追溯性缺口。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品铭牌/包装照片、型号与批次编号、与页面型号的对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反按 Cap. 427 art. 26 通知处理；不遵守通知构成犯罪，art. 32(2) 罚款 €1,164.69–€11,646.87 或监禁 ≤3 年。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (7) Manufacturers shall ensure that electrical equipment which they have placed on the market bears a type, batch or serial number or other element allowing its identification, or, where the size or nature of the electrical equipment does not allow it, that the required information is provided on its packaging or in a document accompanying the electrical equipment.

rules.law_name: Low Voltage Electrical Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.34) 低压电气设备条例
rules.requirement: 制造商须在设备本体（或包装/随附文件）标明名称、注册商号或商标及可联系邮政地址；仅有品牌名而无地址不足。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品与包装照片、制造商名址、说明书中的联系信息。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (8) Manufacturers shall indicate on the electrical equipment their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark and the postal address at which they can be contacted or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the electrical equipment.

rules.law_name: Low Voltage Electrical Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.34) 低压电气设备条例
rules.requirement: 进口商须在设备本体（或包装/随附文件）标明自身名称、商号或商标及可联系的邮政地址；跨境卖家作为进口商时，页面与实物都应能追到该主体。
rules.evidence_needed: 进口商名址、包装照片、报关/进口记录。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (4) Importers shall indicate on the electrical equipment their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark and the postal address at which they can be contacted or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the electrical equipment.

rules.law_name: Low Voltage Electrical Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.34) 低压电气设备条例
rules.requirement: 进口商必须确保设备随附「马耳他语或英语」的说明书与安全信息；只有中文说明书（或仅英文网页而无英文说明书）不满足。
rules.evidence_needed: 说明书实物/PDF 的语言、包装内随附文件清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: Cap. 427 art. 26 通知 + art. 32(2) 罚款 €1,164.69–€11,646.87 或监禁 ≤3 年。制造商一侧的语言标准为「TRD 认定的易理解语言」（reg. 6(9)），进口商一侧明确为马耳他语或英语（reg. 8(5)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (5) Importers shall ensure that the electrical equipment is accompanied by instructions and safety information in either Maltese or English.

rules.law_name: General Product Safety (Implementing) Regulations (S.L. 427.106) 通用产品安全实施条例
rules.requirement: 马耳他把 GPSR 的「易理解语言」明确为马耳他语或英语：产品说明、安全信息与标签必须使用二者之一。这是马耳他区别于其他成员国的最直接语言落点。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品标签、说明书、包装与安全警示照片/PDF；页面内嵌说明书语言。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 GPSR 相关义务按 Cap. 427 art. 26 通知处理，罚则见 art. 32(2)。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the instructions and safety information of the product including the labelling thereof shall be written in either the Maltese or the English language.

rules.law_name: General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988 通用产品安全条例
rules.requirement: 投放市场前，产品必须带型号、批次或序列号等可识别标识（或在该尺寸/性质不允许时置于包装/随附文件），且对消费者清晰可读。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品与包装照片、批次/序列号规则、SKU 与实物对应表。
rules.penalty_or_note: GPSR art. 44 要求成员国设定处罚；马耳他适用 Cap. 427 art. 32（罚款 €1,164.69–€11,646.87 或监禁 ≤3 年）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Manufacturers shall ensure that their products bear a type, batch or serial number or other element enabling the identification of the product and which is easily visible and legible for consumers, or, where the size or nature of the product does not allow it, that the required information is provided on the packaging or in a document accompanying the product.

rules.law_name: General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988 通用产品安全条例
rules.requirement: 产品（或包装/随附文件）必须载明制造商名称、商号或商标、邮政与电子地址；GPSR 比 LVD 多要求「电子地址」。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品铭牌/包装照片、制造商邮箱或网址。
rules.penalty_or_note: GPSR art. 44；马耳他按 Cap. 427 art. 32 处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Manufacturers shall indicate their name, their registered trade name or registered trade mark, their postal and electronic address and, where different, the postal or electronic address of the single contact point at which they can be contacted.

rules.law_name: General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988 通用产品安全条例
rules.requirement: 产品须随附清晰的说明与安全信息，语言为销售成员国确定的易理解语言；在马耳他即马耳他语或英语（S.L. 427.106 reg. 3）。若产品无说明也能安全使用，则不适用。
rules.evidence_needed: 说明书与安全信息文本、随附方式（纸质/二维码）、是否属于「无需说明即可安全使用」。
rules.penalty_or_note: GPSR art. 44；马耳他按 Cap. 427 art. 32 处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Manufacturers shall ensure that their product is accompanied by clear instructions and safety information in a language which can be easily understood by consumers, as determined by the Member State in which the product is made available on the market.

rules.law_name: General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988 通用产品安全条例
rules.requirement: 非欧盟制造商的产品不得投放市场，除非存在一名欧盟境内「负责人」（responsible person）；其名称、商号与邮政/电子地址必须标在产品、包装、包裹或随附文件上。中国品牌需指定欧盟负责人。
rules.evidence_needed: 欧盟负责人的委任文件、名称地址与实际履约能力、产品/包装上的标示照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: GPSR art. 16 + art. 44；马耳他按 Cap. 427 art. 32 处罚（最高 €11,646.87 或监禁 ≤3 年，再犯更高）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A product covered by this Regulation shall not be placed on the market unless there is an economic operator established in the Union who is responsible for the tasks set out in Article 4(3) of Regulation (EU)2019/1020 in respect to that product.

rules.law_name: General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988 通用产品安全条例
rules.requirement: 线上或远程销售的报价必须清楚可见地列出四项：制造商名称与邮政/电子地址；非欧盟制造商时的欧盟负责人名址；可识别产品的信息（含图片、型号）；以及须随附的警示或安全信息（以马耳他语或英语）。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品页截图（含图片与型号）、制造商与负责人名址、安全警示文本与语言。
rules.penalty_or_note: GPSR art. 19 + art. 44；马耳他按 Cap. 427 art. 32 处罚。这是跨境电商商品页最直接的一条硬性清单。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where economic operators make products available on the market online or through other means of distance sales, the offer of those products shall clearly and visibly indicate at least the following information:

rules.law_name: Radio Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.41) 无线电设备条例
rules.requirement: 适用通用充电器的无线电设备（手机、平板、相机、耳机等）须在说明书与包装/机身上标示充电能力与兼容充电设备标签；远程销售时该标签须显示在价格标示附近。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品所属类别（是否在 reg. 4(5) 范围）、标签图样与位置、商品页价格附近的标签展示截图。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反按 Cap. 427 art. 26 通知处理，罚则 art. 32(2)。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In addition to being included in the instructions, when the manufacturers make such radio equipment available to consumers and other end-users, the information shall be also displayed on a label, as set out in Part IV of Schedule VIII.

rules.law_name: Radio Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.41) 无线电设备条例
rules.requirement: 进口商必须确保无线电设备随附「马耳他语或英语」的说明书与安全信息；这是 3C 数码在马耳他的语言落点。
rules.evidence_needed: 说明书/快速入门指南语言、包装内文件清单。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (a) the radio equipment is accompanied by instructions and safety information in either Maltese or English;

rules.law_name: Low Voltage Electrical Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.34) 低压电气设备条例
rules.requirement: 低压电气设备须完成符合性评定、出具 EU 符合性声明（DoC）并加贴 CE 标志后才能投放市场；页面无法证明 DoC 与 CE 时只能写「页面未展示，需向商家核实」。
rules.evidence_needed: DoC 全文（含标准号）、技术文档、CE 标志照片、测试报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: Cap. 427 art. 26 通知 + art. 32(2) 罚款 €1,164.69–€11,646.87 或监禁 ≤3 年；CE 违规另按 reg. 18 要求整改。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) Where compliance of electrical equipment with the safety objectives referred to in regulation 5 and set out in Schedule I has been demonstrated by the conformity assessment procedure referred to in sub-regulation (1), manufacturers shall draw up an EU declaration of conformity and affix the CE marking.

rules.law_name: Low Voltage Electrical Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.34) 低压电气设备条例
rules.requirement: CE 标志须清晰、可读、不可擦除地加贴在设备或其铭牌上；尺寸或性质不允许时才可贴在包装与随附文件上。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品与铭牌高清照片、CE 标志尺寸与位置、包装照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: Cap. 427 art. 26 通知 + art. 32(2)。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) The CE marking shall be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly to the electrical equipment or to its data plate.

rules.law_name: Radio Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.41) 无线电设备条例
rules.requirement: 每件无线电设备须随附 EU 符合性声明副本，或随附简化声明并给出可取得全文的确切网址；商品页只写「CE certified」而不给 DoC 或链接，属证据缺口。
rules.evidence_needed: DoC 全文或简化声明中的 URL、产品型号与 DoC 型号是否对应、链接是否可访问。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (9) Manufacturers shall ensure that each item of radio equipment is accompanied by a copy of the EU declaration of conformity or by a simplified EU declaration of conformity.

rules.law_name: Radio Equipment Regulations (S.L. 427.41) 无线电设备条例
rules.requirement: 无线电设备的 CE 标志须清晰、可读地加贴在设备上，并同样加贴在包装上；无线电设备的安全与电磁兼容要求由 RED 统一覆盖，不再单独适用 LVD。
rules.evidence_needed: 设备与包装上的 CE 标志照片、公告机构编号（如适用）、DoC。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) The CE marking shall be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly to the radio equipment or to its data plate, unless that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of radio equipment. The CE marking shall also be affixed visibly and legibly to the packaging.

rules.law_name: Electrical Accessories Regulations (S.L. 427.51) 电气配件条例
rules.requirement: 任何人不得构造、进口、投放市场、供应或投入使用不符合本条例的电气配件，或装有不符合本条例电气配件的电气设备。
rules.evidence_needed: 插头型式照片、插头/保险丝规格、符合性评定文件。
rules.penalty_or_note: 按 Cap. 427 一般罚则处理（art. 12 犯罪 + art. 32(2) 罚款）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (b) No person may construct, import, place on the market, supply or put into service any electrical accessories or electrical equipment fitted with electrical accessories which do not comply with the provisions of these regulations.

rules.law_name: Electrical Accessories Regulations (S.L. 427.51) 电气配件条例
rules.requirement: 家用标准插头必须内置符合 MSA BS 1362 的保险丝，且为经符合性评定机构批准的 BS 1363 型式（马耳他使用英式 G 型三脚插头）。配欧标/美标插头的家电需配转换插头或更换为 BS 1363 插头。
rules.evidence_needed: 插头照片（三脚、带保险丝）、插头型号批准记录、BS 1363/BS 1362 测试报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: Cap. 427 art. 12 犯罪 + art. 32(2) 罚款 €1,164.69–€11,646.87 或监禁 ≤3 年。Schedule I 对「非马耳他插头单独供货」设有豁免，需逐情形判断。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (b) A standard plug shall incorporate a fuse link which conforms to MSA BS 1362.

rules.law_name: Product Safety Act (Cap. 427) 产品安全法
rules.requirement: 生产者只能把安全产品投放市场；某产品是否「安全」需结合用途、标签、警示与可预见使用判断，不能由页面文案单独定性。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品测试报告、风险评估、警示与说明书、事故/投诉记录。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) Producers shall be obliged to only place safe products on the market.

rules.law_name: Product Safety Act (Cap. 427) 产品安全法
rules.requirement: 销售、出租、展示或为销售而持有不符合本法或其项下条例的产品构成犯罪；一般罚则为罚款 €1,164.69–€11,646.87 或监禁不超过 3 年，或二者并罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 执法文书、产品符合性证据；本库只记上限，不预测实际处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) A person found guilty of any other offence under this Act shall be liable, on conviction, to a fine (multa) of not less than one thousand and one hundred and sixty-four euro and sixty-nine cents (1,164.69) but not exceeding eleven thousand and six hundred and forty-six euro and eighty-seven cents (11,646.87) or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding three years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

rules.law_name: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) 通用数据保护条例
rules.requirement: 收集个人数据时须提供：控制者身份与联系方式、DPO 联系方式（如适用）、处理目的与法律依据、正当利益（如适用）、接收方类别、跨境传输与保障措施。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策全文、收集点（注册/下单/订阅）截图、处理活动记录（ROPA）、DPO 任命文件。
rules.penalty_or_note: GDPR art. 83(5)(b)：最高 €20,000,000 或全球年营业额 4%（取高者）；马耳他监管机关为 IDPC。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (a)the identity and the contact details of the controller and, where applicable, of the controller's representative;

rules.law_name: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) 通用数据保护条例
rules.requirement: 除 art. 13(1) 外还须告知：保存期限或判定标准、访问/更正/删除/限制/反对/可携权、撤回同意权、向监管机关投诉权、提供数据的义务与后果、自动化决策与画像。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策对应段落、权利行使渠道、保存期限政策、自动化决策说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: GDPR art. 83(5)(b)：最高 €20,000,000 或全球年营业额 4%。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (b)the existence of the right to request from the controller access to and rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing concerning the data subject or to object to processing as well as the right to data portability;

rules.law_name: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) 通用数据保护条例
rules.requirement: 告知须以简明、透明、易懂、易获取的形式、用清晰平实的语言提供；可与隐私政策并列，但不能只在长篇法律文本中埋没。
rules.evidence_needed: 告知文本可读性、层级与入口位置、移动端展示效果。
rules.penalty_or_note: GDPR art. 83(5)(b)：最高 €20,000,000 或全球年营业额 4%。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The controller shall take appropriate measures to provide any information referred to in Articles 13 and 14 and any communication under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 relating to processing to the data subject in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form, using clear and plain language, in particular for any information addressed specifically to a child.

rules.law_name: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) 通用数据保护条例
rules.requirement: 违反 art. 12–22（含告知义务）可处最高 €20,000,000 或全球年营业额 4% 的行政罚款，取高者。
rules.evidence_needed: IDPC 决定文书、营业额数据；本库只记上限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Infringements of the following provisions shall, in accordance with paragraph 2, be subject to administrative fines up to 20 000 000 EUR, or in the case of an undertaking, up to 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is higher:

rules.law_name: Processing of Personal Data (Electronic Communications Sector) Regulations (S.L. 586.01) 电子通信领域个人数据处理条例
rules.requirement: 在用户终端设备存储信息或访问已存储信息（含 Cookie/追踪像素），须先取得用户同意，并事先向其提供清晰、全面的信息；仅技术上必要的传输或用户明确请求的服务除外。
rules.evidence_needed: Cookie 同意层截图与录屏、同意前是否已设置非必要 Cookie（网络请求记录）、Cookie 清单与用途。
rules.penalty_or_note: S.L. 586.01 reg. 13：每项违规行政罚款不超过 €23,293.73，持续违规每日另罚 €2,329.37，由 IDPC 决定。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The storing of information or the gaining of access to information stored in the terminal equipment of a subscriber or user shall only be allowed on condition that the subscriber or user concerned has given his consent, having been provided by the controller with clear and comprehensive information in terms of article 19 of the Act.
